verdict.rationale: Workable's own API documents read access to account data and states it gives 'full control over your data'. Endpoints return jobs, candidates, events, requisitions and offers, with offers explicitly returned as JSON. There is no documented one-click or bulk full-account export, and no stated guarantee that all data (attachments, notes, reports) can be exported in open formats before leaving. Missing for 10: a dedicated bulk/full-account export feature, coverage of all data types (files, notes, evaluations), documented open-format export options beyond API JSON, offboarding/data-retention guidance, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
